title: Know where the small model stops (18 Nov 2026)
summary: Perplexity distills a 27B decision model into a 4B one by matching its probabilities, a swap test across 24 papers shows when a zero-shot decision model can replace a fine-tuned classifier, an ICD-10 coder calls a big model on only a third of cases and beats calling it on all of them, decision models extract pathology fields fast but miss numbers and unstated fields, and Japanese clinical extraction shows how a tight output-token limit makes a fine-tuned model look weak.
